Root Cause
The original code had a race condition:

Page loads → state is initialized as empty ({ initiatives: [] })
bindCollapse() runs and attaches listeners that can trigger save()
loadState() starts fetching from the server (async)
Before the fetch completes, any interaction (or even the initial render) could trigger save(), which would write the empty state to the server — wiping all data
The Fix
Added an isLoaded guard flag:

javascript
📋 Copy💾 Save
💾 Workspace
let isLoaded = false;

function save() {
  if (!isLoaded) return;  // ← Block saves until load completes
  ...
}

function saveNow() {
  if (!isLoaded) return;  // ← Block saves until load completes
  ...
}

async function loadState() {
  // ... fetch from server ...
  isLoaded = true;  // ← Only NOW allow saves
  render();
}
